source: Of the artists who charted on Spotify from January 2020 to December 2021, 332 had never charted before. 25% of them came from TikTok.
claim: 84 of the 332 artists who first charted in 2020-2021 came from TikTok, counting both those marked as TikTok-related and the TikTok-viral artists, 25.3%.
